44	/** Screens are addressed by a small route string so the back stack survives recreation. */
45	sealed interface Route {
46	    data object Shop : Route
47	    data class Detail(val productId: Int) : Route
48	    data class Checkout(val productId: Int) : Route
49	}
50	
51	internal fun Route.encode(): String = when (this) {
52	    Route.Shop -> "shop"
53	    is Route.Detail -> "detail:$productId"
54	    is Route.Checkout -> "checkout:$productId"
55	}
56	
57	internal fun decodeRoute(raw: String): Route = when {
58	    raw.startsWith("detail:") -> raw.removePrefix("detail:").toIntOrNull()?.let { Route.Detail(it) } ?: Route.Shop
59	    raw.startsWith("checkout:") -> raw.removePrefix("checkout:").toIntOrNull()?.let { Route.Checkout(it) } ?: Route.Shop
60	    else -> Route.Shop
61	}
62	
63	/** Holds the current route in [SavedStateHandle] so it is restored after process death. */
64	class NavigationViewModel(private val handle: SavedStateHandle) : ViewModel() {
65	    var route by mutableStateOf(decodeRoute(handle.get<String>(ROUTE_KEY) ?: Route.Shop.encode()))
66	        private set
67	
68	    fun go(to: Route) {
69	        route = to
70	        handle[ROUTE_KEY] = to.encode()
71	    }
72	
73	    private companion object {
74	        const val ROUTE_KEY = "route"
75	    }
76	}
77	
78	@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class, ExperimentalComposeUiApi::class)
79	@Composable
80	fun MonkeyMartApp(nav: NavigationViewModel = viewModel()) {
81	    val route = nav.route
82	    fun go(to: Route) = nav.go(to)
83	
84	    BackHandler(enabled = route != Route.Shop) {
85	        go(if (route is Route.Checkout) Route.Detail(route.productId) else Route.Shop)
86	    }
87	
88	    Scaffold(
89	        modifier = Modifier
90	            .fillMaxSize()
91	            .semantics { testTagsAsResourceId = true },
92	        topBar = { TopAppBar(title = { Text("MonkeyMart") }) },
93	    ) { padding ->
94	        val content = Modifier.padding(padding)
95	        when (route) {
96	            Route.Shop -> ShopScreen(onProductClick = { go(Route.Detail(it)) }, modifier = content)
97	            is Route.Detail -> DetailScreen(route.productId, onBuyNow = { go(Route.Checkout(it)) }, modifier = content)
98	            is Route.Checkout -> CheckoutScreen(route.productId, modifier = content)
99	        }
100	    }
101	}
